NORMAL PATH: exactly 1 destination, equal to the requester's own email. THE MUTANT HITS THE REAL GUARD: _client_recipients is SPLIT FROM the guard specifically so a test can replace the derivation with a two-element list and have notify_client REFUSE -- had they been one expression, the only way to test the guard would have been to re-implement it in the test, which tests the copy. THE ISOLATED WRAPPER GIVES IT ITS OWN TOKEN: WE_CLIENT_NOT_SINGULAR, asserted present, and WE_CLIENT_SEND_FAILED asserted ABSENT -- a leak averted is not an operational failure and must not be logged as one.
